name: Crazy★Rabbits -Wakaresasegyou no Usagiri Jimusho-
original_name: クレイジー★ラビッツ 別れさせ業の兎桐事務所
source:
The protagonist was an office lady working at an ordinary company... Until 3 months ago, that was.

One day, the company she worked at went bankrupt.
Not being able to find another job left her in dire straits. She got kicked out of her apartment and had to lodge at an Internet café. However, a poster advertising a job vacancy caught her eye. She thought to herself, "I don't have the luxury to pick and choose at the moment!" and went to the 2nd floor of an old live music bar as directed on the poster. In there was a small office littered with trash and covered in dust. 

She found out that the small office ran a professional "relationship ending" business from the dull middle-aged man that employed her. Though feeling uncertain about an industry she had never heard of until now, the protagonist made her first step towards becoming a "professional couple breaker".

This is a story about the protagonist that coincidentally came to help out the "couple breaking" business, their "extreme" clients and "strange" covert operatives who worked there.

[Translation of official website story summary]
translation:
主人公原本只是一家普通公司的职员…至少三个月前还是如此。

一天，她所在的公司突然破产。
找不到新工作令她陷入绝境，既被房东赶出公寓，又只能寄宿网吧。然而，一张招聘海报引起了她的注意。她心想：“现在根本没有挑三拣四的余地！”便按照海报指示，来到一家老旧Live House二楼。那里有一间垃圾遍地、布满灰尘的小办公室。

从雇用自己的沉闷中年男子口中，她得知这间小办公室经营着专业的“分手代理”业务。尽管对这个闻所未闻的行业感到不安，主人公仍迈出了成为“职业拆散专家”的第一步。

这是一个关于主人公偶然加入“分手代理”业务，与各种“极端”客户及事务所里“古怪”秘密行动人员共同工作的故事。

[翻译自官方网站故事简介]
